product_overview: A lightweight React-based e-commerce demo that lets visitors browse products, authenticated users simulate purchases and view order history, and authenticated admins perform UI-level product CRUD. All data is stored in local mock data and authentication is in-memory for demonstration purposes.
core_goals: Provide a browsable product catalog with detail pages using local mock data.
Support a simple in-memory authentication flow for a hard-coded test account.
Allow authenticated users to perform simulated purchases and view order history.
Expose an admin UI for adding, editing, and deleting products in local state.
Keep the app runnable locally with no external services or persistent backend.

features.name: Authentication Gate
features.description: In-memory authentication using a hard-coded test account that enables access to protected routes (Orders and Admin) and supports login/logout state changes.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter example@gmail.com and 123456789 -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /orders -> See order history content
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit login form -> See authentication error and remain unauthenticated

features.name: Product Catalog Browsing
features.description: Browse products loaded from local mock data, inspect metadata, and open a product's detail page. Buy actions are available only when authenticated.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Browse product cards and metadata -> Open a product's details -> Navigate to /product/:id -> See product image, category, price, and description
Navigate to / -> Browse product cards -> Attempt to initiate a purchase while unauthenticated -> See buy action disabled or a login-required prompt

features.name: Product Details and Purchase Feedback
features.description: View a product's full details via route param and trigger a simulated purchase that shows immediate success feedback when authenticated.
user_flows: Navigate to /product/:id -> View product image, category, price, and description -> Initiate purchase while authenticated -> Observe success snackbar and see order reflected in order history at /orders
Navigate to /product/:id -> View product details -> Initiate purchase while unauthenticated -> See login required message or purchase prevented

features.name: Order History View
features.description: Protected view that displays mock order history entries (product, price, date) for authenticated users.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter example@gmail.com and 123456789 -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /orders -> See order cards with product, price, and date
Navigate to /orders while unauthenticated -> Be redirected to /login

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Protected admin UI to add, edit, and delete products in local component state with snackbar notifications for CRUD actions. Changes are not persisted across page reloads.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter example@gmail.com and 123456789 -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /admin -> Fill product form and submit to add a product -> Observe new product in the admin list and see success snackbar -> Edit an existing product and save changes -> Observe updated product in the admin list and see success snackbar -> Delete an existing product -> Observe product removed from the admin list and see success snackbar
Navigate to /admin while unauthenticated -> Be redirected to /login
Navigate to /login -> Login and add or edit products in /admin -> Refresh the page -> See admin product changes lost due to in-memory/mock data reset

routes.description: Product catalog page showing product cards with view-details and buy actions
Login form that validates hard-coded test credentials
Product detail page for a selected catalog item
Protected page showing order history cards from mock data
Protected admin product management page for UI-level CRUD

features.description: Local in-memory auth context with login/logout and protected routes
user_interactions: Access protected Orders/Admin links after successful login
Click Logout to return to unauthenticated state

user_interactions: Click View Details on a product card

known_limitations.issue: No backend API integration; all data operations use local mock data with simulated delay
known_limitations.impact: Data is not persisted and resets on refresh

known_limitations.issue: Authentication is in-memory only and uses hard-coded credentials
known_limitations.impact: Session does not persist across reloads and is not secure for production

known_limitations.issue: Buy action is disabled when unauthenticated even though handlers include login redirect logic
known_limitations.impact: Redirect path in buy handler is effectively unreachable from disabled button state

known_limitations.issue: Admin CRUD updates only local UI state
known_limitations.impact: Product changes do not propagate to catalog data source or persistent storage
